test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Few people are sitting in a straight row facing north. A is sixth to the left of C. D is in fourth position to the right of A. Exactly two people are sitting between H and A. B is fourth to the right of C. E is an immediate neighbour of both D and C, F is second to the left of E. C is eighth from the right end. There are exactly six persons sitting between G and F. G is third from one of the extreme ends. How many people are sitting in the row in total?
solution:
**Explanation:**

 
• C is eighth from the right end.
 
• A is sixth to the left of C.
 
• B is fourth to the right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89144ef9b9ebe5adaf59edd1130ae61d4812542e67d91d815d55037c84013a89.png] 

 
• D is in fourth position to the right of A.
 
• E is an immediate neighbour of both D and C.
 
• F is second to the left of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12a142a18cef47c123da9c75b36df86390a2e3fe90dddfdfc124e068af2ab8c0.png] 

 
• There are exactly six persons sitting between G and F. 
 
• G is third from one of the extreme ends.
 
• Exactly two people are sitting between H and A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88bc998f4e9b47bce14552dc0e572934d7feae855bf76981fcefaf5ecce19533.png] 

 
• Total number of people sitting in the arrangement = 20

Hence,** 20 **is the** correct answer.**
